nanocap_mean_reversion.author: meridian-nanocap-v1

token_criteria.notes: Nanocap and low microcap tokens that have recently dumped hard. Prefer tokens with real narrative and organic volume - not freshly launched, not near ATH. Token must have a DLMM pool on Meteora. Current live discovery is GMGN-first with direct Meteora Pool Discovery/detail validation before deploy. RSI(2) <= 30 on the 5-minute chart is required before deploy. Do NOT deploy into pumps or tokens near ATH. You are bottom-fishing: waiting for a V-shaped dump and catching the bounce as an LP.

entry.condition: RSI(2) <= 30 on 5_MINUTE confirmed - deploy SOL-only into bins below current price
entry.notes: Deploy SOL only (amount_y, amount_x=0). All liquidity sits below the current price. As the token dumps further into your range, SOL is passively converted to token at progressively lower prices - DCA averaging. On the bounce, token converts back to SOL plus fees earned throughout the dip. Zero-slippage entry. Deploy only after a clear dump.

range.notes: Default 85 bins below, 0 above. Live deploys may clamp/adjust around this configured wide downside range while preserving SOL-only bid_ask shape. bins_above MUST stay 0 - SOL-only deployment.

exit.notes: Current live exits: absolute TP at 25%, trailing TP enabled at +6% with 3pp giveback, profit-giveback emergency enabled at peak >= 6% with floor 2%, soft stop-loss -8% with 15s confirmation, hard stop-loss -15%, early dump -8% within 20 minutes, low-yield close after 60m, and OOR hard-close/rebalance handling. Do not scale or tighten profit exits from this strategy text alone; use snapshot replay and a shadow/default-off canary first.
